command: set -eu; DIR="$HOME/tracker-field-captures/2026-09-13-post-walk-v68"; serial="$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}')"; apk_path="$(adb -s "$serial" shell pm path io.blueeye | sed -n 's/^package://p' | head -1 | tr -d '\r')"; if test -n "$apk_path"; then adb -s "$serial" pull "$apk_path" "$DIR/installed-base.apk" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; if command -v sqlite3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then sqlite3 "$DIR/tracker_database" 'PRAGMA integrity_check;' > "$DIR/sqlite-integrity.txt" 2>&1 || true; fi; rm -f "$DIR/SHA256SUMS.txt"; (cd "$DIR" && shasum -a 256 * > SHA256SUMS.txt); chmod -R go-rwx "$DIR"; echo CAPTURE_DIR=$DIR; echo CAPTURE_FILES_BEGIN; find "$DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -exec basename {} \; | sort; echo CAPTURE_FILES_END; if test -f "$DIR/sqlite-integrity.txt"; then printf 'SQLITE_INTEGRITY='; tr '\n' ' ' < "$DIR/sqlite-integrity.txt" | head -c 200; echo; fi
